_provenance: Authoritative stimulus playlist for the current Unity clip-log format (single comma-delimited CSV per session folder; SourceType/SpeakerChannelIndex/SourcePosition*/ClipNumber/ClipRepetition/ClipName/ClipStart/ClipEnd -- see zyldoa/unity.py:parse_clip_log). Stimulus family (pink noise / phonemes / 250-1000-5000 Hz tone / phone ringing / applause) is read from the session's CSV FILENAME, not any column or ClipNumber (which is reused 0-9 with different meaning per family), and mapped to these indices via zyldoa/unity.py:FAMILY_STIM_INDEX. The legacy 8-entry TrialDefGenerator.cs playlist (tones, phone ringing, applause, speech) was retired 2026-09-25 when the old TrialData/FrameData CSV parsing was removed; entries 2-6 (added 2026-10-03) reintroduce tones/phone ringing/applause under the new clip-log format, each its own stand-alone recording (not mixed with pink noise/phonemes in one file). type drives the DOA analysis band (broadband_noise = 0.4-1.2 kHz; tone/complex_tone = +/-1/6 octave around dominant_hz); phonemes and phone ringing additionally get the adaptive early-window search (zyldoa/pipeline.py:ADAPTIVE_WIN_LABELS) since, like speech, they have a variable/intermittent envelope. The 5000 Hz tone sits above both the first-order intensity model's validity ceiling (~1.1 kHz) and the SH-SRP cross-check's order-3 ceiling (~3.3 kHz on the ZM-1); treat its DOA numbers as informational, not validated the way the lower tones are. `clip_duration_s` (added 2026-10-06): the stimulus's actual playback length, used by pipeline.py:estimate_doa to size the analysis window -- the legacy fixed/adaptive windows (ANALYSIS_WIN up to 0.40s, adaptive search up to 1.90s) were tuned for the original ~1 s pink-noise/phonemes clips; the five families added 2026-10-03 are short 200 ms bursts (per their '...200ms...' folder-naming) and phonemes run up to ~0.52 s (measured from real ClipStart/ClipEnd), so without a duration-aware window the analysis would run past the clip into post-stimulus silence/reverberation, corrupting both the in-band SNR gate and the DOA estimate itself. null means 'long/legacy stimulus, use the existing fixed windows unchanged' (pink noise only).
